title: Retail collaborative practice agreement may not permit Schedule II through V prescribing
rule_summary: Under M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2(c)(5), no collaborative practice agreement in the retail drug business setting may permit the prescribing of schedule II through V controlled substances, as defined in section 3 of chapter 94C.
exam_relevance: Tests that the statute closes Schedules II through V, Schedule V included, to any retail collaborative practice agreement.
common_confusions: The statutory sentence is addressed to the agreement: no agreement in the retail drug business setting may permit the prescribing.
The range runs through Schedule V.
verification_notes: Read in the current text of M.G.L. c. 112, s. 24B1/2 on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-17.
